text:
ellie.cs: Heads-up 1: TremorLabs reserved pool scheduled for blue-green flip tomorrow 07:00 PT. We need final quota sanity, autoscale policy signoff, and a 30m soak plan. Can someone own the check?

tj.eng: I'll own the autoscale policy review. What are the customer SLA targets?

ellie.cs: SLA: p95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.3%. They want a 15% surge buffer for first 20m.

ana.ops: Quota layout: us-east-1a=50, us-east-1b=30, us-east-1c=20. Commit tag tl-commit-2026-03-22. Also note they enabled model-fallback routing in case of OOMs.

choir.sre: Suggest we start with policy "conservative-gradual" for the first 10m (scale_step=1 replica/60s) and then switch to "baseline-fast". We had a related issue where instant scaling caused burst gc.

tj.eng: Good call. I'll prepare two smoke tests:
- steady: 65% expected QPS for 20m
- soak: gentle ramp to 110% over 8m, hold 12m, then cool down 10m
Runner: k6 script + distributed runners. Example command:
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m tremor_steady.js --out json=steady1.json
```

ellie.cs: Please capture kernel/JIT logs and KV hit-rate. Also we need warmup strategy: prefix priming vs soft-replicas.

tj.eng: Will record /metrics, /proc profiles, and KV occupancy. Plan: test both priming and +1 warm replica (10m) and compare p95.

ana.ops: I've added a temporary quota slot for +1 replica if needed (approval required from finance but pre-authorized up to 4 hours). Portal id: quota-TL-888.

choir.sre: Quick checklist note: ensure OOM alert thresholds lowered to 60% memory for this customer during first 2 hours. I'll put a watch schedule.

ellie.cs: Can we keep the customer on the loop? I'll send the go/no-go email after verification run at 06:00 PT.

test-bot: Artifact upload: s3://redwood-ops/tremor/bringup/1768822222/steady1.json uploaded

tj.eng: Steady run results: p95=185ms, errors=0.12%, KV hit-rate=78%, avg CPU 68%. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/tremor/1768822222/steady-report.zip

tj.eng: Soak run (priming enabled) results: small cold-window at start ~70s where p95=420ms, then stabilized to 190ms. Soak hold produced 0.18% errors.

tj.eng: Soak run (warm-replica) results: no cold window, p95 steady at 175ms, cpu avg 82%, slightly higher token cost. Artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/tremor/1768822222/soak-comparison.zip

choir.sre: Notes: warm-replica avoided the kernel JIT penalty but used ~+12% capacity. Priming reduced the penalty but didn't eliminate it for replicas that got the JIT path.

ellie.cs: Tradeoff decision 1: Use priming + conservative-gradual autoscale for first 15m. If p95>350ms during initial 5m, fall back to warm-replica plan (auto-approve short bump).

ana.ops: Priming flag toggled in production for TremorLabs. Rollback steps added: revert priming, spin up warm replica, route minor traffic to fallback model if p95>600ms. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/tremor-bringup

tj.eng: Final verification scheduled 06:00 PT. Tagging @choir.sre on the run. :eyes:

choir.sre: I'll be watching from 05:45-07:15 PT. Pager policy updated.

ellie.cs: I'll email AE + customer with the plan and invite to the 08:00 PT post-mortem/check-in. Thanks everyone.

test-bot: Final upload: s3://redwood-ops/tremor/bringup/1768822222/final-artifacts.tar.gz
